svg.title: Weight loss in key trials: best arm vs placebo
svg.desc: Weight loss in key trials: best arm vs placebo. Petrelintide · ZUPREME 1 · 28 wk: 9.8% vs 1.7% on placebo (Peer reviewed). Petrelintide · ZUPREME-2 (type 2 diabetes) · 28 wk: 9.2% vs 2.0% on placebo (Company topline). Eloralintide · phase 2 · 48 wk: 20.0% vs 0.4% on placebo (Peer reviewed). Eloralintide alone (type 2 diabetes) · 48 wk: 12.3% vs 3.0% on placebo (Company topline). Cagrilintide · phase 2 · 26 wk: 10.8% vs 3.0% on placebo (Peer reviewed). Cagrilintide alone · REDEFINE 1 · 68 wk: 11.5% vs 3.0% on placebo (Peer reviewed). CagriSema · REDEFINE 1 · 68 wk: 20.4% vs 3.0% on placebo (Peer reviewed). Wegovy · STEP 1 · 68 wk: 14.9% vs 2.4% on placebo (Peer reviewed). Zepbound · SURMOUNT-1 · 72 wk: 20.9% vs 3.1% on placebo (Peer reviewed).

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
